edits.before: const fields = { entity_id: entity.entityId, ...(version === "v1" ? { name: (entity as EntityV1).name } : {}) };

rationale: The removed `name` field from the Entity protobuf schema must be eliminated from all construction and read operations in the TypeScript runtime. The first edit removes the conditional spread of `name` into the fields object, as it is no longer part of the v1 schema. The second edit removes the `name` field during entity construction for testing purposes, preserving the same test coverage but with an empty string value (implicitly) instead of a literal name.
assumptions: The generated TypeScript bindings will handle reserved fields gracefully without requiring explicit handling in the codebase.
No other runtime logic depends on the presence or absence of `name` beyond what is explicitly shown in the source context.
